questions.q: How many custom domains can a Microsoft Purview Data Map have, beyond the one default domain?
options: Zero — only the default domain is allowed
Up to four
Unlimited
Exactly one
questions.explain: Every Data Map starts with one default domain, and you can create up to four custom domains beyond that, each with its own administrators.

questions.q: What is the relationship between a domain and a collection?
options: They are the same thing, just different names
A collection is a nested grouping of sources and assets inside a domain
A domain is nested inside a collection
Collections replace domains entirely in the new portal
questions.explain: A domain is the top-level container; a collection is a nested grouping inside a domain used to organize sources by business flow and apply fine-grained access control.

questions.q: Which role can run an existing scan but cannot, on its own, create a new scan rule?
options: Data source administrator alone
Data reader alone
Insights reader alone
Workflow administrator alone
questions.explain: A user with only the Data source admin role can run new scans using an existing scan rule, but creating new scan rules requires also holding Data reader or Data curator.

questions.q: By default, does a subcollection inherit role assignments from its parent collection?
options: No, every collection must have its permissions set independently
Yes, inheritance is on by default and can be restricted per collection with one exception
Only if the subcollection has fewer than five users
Inheritance only applies to the Data source admin role
questions.explain: Permissions are inherited from the parent collection by default. The Restrict inherited permissions toggle can turn this off for a specific collection — except permissions assigned at the default domain level, which cannot currently be restricted.

questions.q: When registering a new data source, what two things do you choose that connect it into the domain/collection structure?
options: A username and password only
A domain, then a collection within it (or domain only)
A scan rule set and a classification only
A region and a pricing tier only
questions.explain: Registering a source means selecting a domain and then a collection inside it (or choosing 'Select domain only'), which determines where the source and its assets live in the Data Map hierarchy.
